subject: Human Body
title: HIV and AIDS
description: A fast breakdown of HIV and AIDS for builders.

hook.text: HIV doesn't kill you directly. It dismantles your immune system so that ordinary infections become lethal.

buildup.text: HIV infects CD4+ helper T cells. These are the coordinators that activate nearly every other immune response.

discovery.text: As CD4 counts drop below 200 cells per microliter, the immune system collapses. This stage is called AIDS.

twist.text: Modern antiretroviral drugs keep HIV suppressed indefinitely. Treated patients live normal lifespans but aren't cured.

climax.text: HIV exploits the immune system's own command structure. By killing the generals, it defeats the entire army.

punchline.text: HIV attacks the immune system's leaders. The army falls apart.

quiz.question: Why is HIV so devastating to the immune system?
options: It produces toxins that destroy all blood cells
It specifically targets helper T cells that coordinate immunity
It blocks the production of red blood cells in bone marrow
